IMPORTANT.description: The new ADR-0020 acceptance row requires that 'a body that cannot be parsed for recovery yields an error' with no body or key bytes, but no deliverable defines that path. D5 (:129-146) maps results to Attestation only. It does not say when recovery runs (before the send, per OBS-B, or after), what the error is (an ErrorCode, which one), or whether it makes the backend Failed with nothing sent. A test is required for behavior the sprint never specifies.
IMPORTANT.remediation: Add one sentence to D5. Recovery runs on the serialized body before it is handed to send_with_busy_retry. A parse failure is a JevError (state the ErrorCode) that makes that backend Failed with nothing sent. The message, fix hint and details carry no body or key bytes.

MINOR.description: Sentence counting for the ADR-0019 r-1 interim bullet 1. The architecture.md text (arch:375-382) has three sentences: (1) 'The sentence ... now reads: ... Attestation ... `equal` is derived: true only when every backend is Matched.', (2) 'Until r-2b ... a live run reports equal = false.', (3) 'The engine still gives every backend the one shared bundle.' D7 says 'its first two sentences (per-backend Attestation; equal true only when every backend is Matched) stay' and 'the sentences ... are superseded'. The Attestation and derived-equal clauses are one sentence, and the superseded 'Until r-2b ...' text is one sentence. The intent is clear (the first sentence and the last stay, the middle one goes), but 'first two sentences' and the plural 'sentences' are inexact in a sprint whose purpose is sentence-level precision. The same wording is in the dispositions row ARCH-R2B-003.
MINOR.remediation: Reword to 'its first sentence (per-backend Attestation; `equal` derived) and its last sentence (one shared bundle) stay; the middle sentence beginning "Until r-2b" is superseded'.

MINOR.description: The ADR-0025 bullet-3 pointer line says input_sha256 'is null only for a backend that was not sent or failed'. An Unattested backend (sent, but reported no digest) also leaves it null, and bullet 3 itself keeps Unattested as a state.
MINOR.remediation: Say 'is null only for a backend that was not sent, failed, or reported no digest (Unattested)'.

MINOR.description: The ADR-0002 acceptance row requires 'a test rejects a payload with both questions and criteria and one with neither (INPUT_INVALID)', but the test has no name and no Required validation line. Branch B is blocked, so this is a completeness note.
